invariants.rationale: Method always returns a non-null iterator by construction, as it wraps a singletonList().iterator().
partitionPath is passed to a handle and likely required to be non-null for writes.
fileId is used to uniquely identify the file created and likely required to be non-null.
instantTime identifies the commit/version and is required for Hoodie operations; typically cannot be null.
recordMap is used to create and write records, so expected to be non-null.
